grades: Rising high school juniors and seniors with a background in biology, chemistry or research
name: Neuroscience Camp for High School Students, Drexel
org: Drexel University Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences and Professional Studies
what_you_do: This is a 10-day commuter camp. It has lectures and lab experiences. The topics are current topics in neuroscience.
who_can_apply: Rising high school juniors and seniors with a biology, chemistry or research background. Admission is competitive.
deadline_text: 2026 deadline was April 3, 2026. The page says 2027 Summer Institutes information will be posted this winter.
how_to_apply: Submit transcripts and two letters of recommendation. Contact camp assistant Ipatia Daigle (ied26@drexel.edu) or director Dr. Jed Shumsky (js52@drexel.edu).
notes: Drexel runs other Summer Institutes (arts and sciences, business, engineering, design, nursing, public health); their pages did not list grades, costs or dates when read.
